scope: 2023 English Uprising v23-10-12, standard 2–4-player multiplayer including required two-player Rival, optional standard CHOAM; no solo, Rival variants, six-player teams or cross-game expansions. Relevant official FAQ January 13 2025 clarifications included.
grading: All requested material parts required; abstention partial, contradiction incorrect. Grade semantics independent of support label. Unsupported guesses separately flagged. No cross-answer borrowing.

answers.expected_answer: Shuffle all four III cards at the bottom, five randomly dealt of nine II cards above, one randomly dealt of three I cards on top: ten total. Return unused cards to the box without looking.
Four players start at 1 VP; three at 0. Each has two Agents on Leader and third beside board, three troops in garrison with remaining nine in supply, and one water.

May Reveal early; no more turns this phase after Reveal. Only cards remaining in hand and just revealed supply Reveal effects, not Agent-turn cards. Clean Up puts all Agent and Reveal cards in discard pile.
Entry costs paid immediately before any card or space effects; cannot use later gains to pay entry. One card sends one Agent using one matching icon. No-icon card cannot be played on an Agent turn.

May deploy all three newly recruited plus at most two older garrison troops, five total. Normal deployment unavailable at noncombat space. Recruit from own supply into garrison; empty supply prevents recruiting.

Spy Agent icon permits a connected space without recalling Spy. Infiltrate recalls own connected Spy to bypass another player Agent. Gather Intelligence recalls own connected Spy to draw, chosen immediately after placement before card/space effects. Same Spy cannot do both; separate Spies can.
Strength 11 (2+2+3+4). No units means zero strength regardless swords. Without a unit cannot participate in Combat Intrigue.

May act again after earlier pass; closes only when all involved players pass consecutively. Adjust strength for effects. After all rewards troops return to supply not garrison, sandworms to bank, Combat markers reset zero.
Each tied first gets second reward and nobody wins or takes card. In four-player game remaining players compete for third; in three-player game no further rewards. Zero strength never rewarded.
One or more sandworms doubles, never quadruples. Control and battle icons do not double. Optional reward cost may be paid second time: 3 spice for 1 VP or 6 for 2, not free second VP.

After winning and taking Conflict card face up in supply check another face-up Conflict or Objective with same icon; must flip pair face down for 1 VP. At Endgame wild can match any of three icons in supply, pair flipped for 1 VP.

Reach 2 gets 1 VP lost below 2. Reach 4 gets track bonus retained if falling below, can earn again on re-reaching. First to 4 gets Alliance and its VP; tie does not steal, opponent must rise higher. Transfer loses old holder VP and gives new holder VP.

Before between or after Reveal effects; can pool and split. Refill Row to five immediately; may buy replacement with remaining Persuasion. Acquired card face-up discard, cannot use immediately; unspent Persuasion lost.

Makers phase adds one bonus spice on each unoccupied Maker space, accumulating; visiting collects all bonus spice. Shield Wall blocks worms at Arrakeen, Spice Refinery, Imperial Basin until removed to box. Maker Hooks prerequisite when specified; summoning directly bank to Conflict, never garrison.
Check in Recall at end of round, not immediately at 10 VP. Resolve Endgame Intrigue first then highest VP wins. Ties spice then Solari then water then garrisoned troops.

20 standard contracts: two face up, eighteen in bank. Add four Intrigue and four Imperium; Shaddam optional. Ten contrasting-back contracts are only Rise of Ix compatibility, excluded from standard setup.

Take one of two face-up into supply then refill face up from bank; if all taken gain 2 Solari (also without module). Harvest: visit Maker and gain specified total spice that turn including other sources. Immediate upon taking. Acquire The Spice Must Flow on next acquiring that card.
Cannot complete now; must have held contract when Agent sent, wait future turn. Announce completion, gain printed rewards, flip face down and leave in supply.

One shared Rival. Rival gets Ornithopter Objective, other two randomly humans; Rival never First Player. Marker alternates humans, Rival considered clockwise from First Player and acts between humans each round. Takes Agent turns while it has Agent in supply, never Reveals.
answers.novelty: Required two-player setup and turn order

answers.expected_answer: Occupied: ignore and reveal again. Place Spy tries empty designated post, ignore placement if none, then reveal another card regardless because no Agent sent. Ignore normal space costs/effects; use Hagal effects only. Empty deck or Reshuffle: immediately reshuffle Hagal and continue.
